extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create or find a Wikipedia article (Wikipedia contributors / editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance and checks for creating or locating a Wikipedia page when an exact-title article does not exist (e.g., steps to create a new article, alternatives if you cannot create one, and diagnostic checks if the title was deleted or recently created).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed status required to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed you cannot create the page directly; consider the alternative submission routes (article wizard or request a new article).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request new article if you cannot create it
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These paths let contributors who are not autoconfirmed or who prefer guided help to propose content for review rather than directly creating a live page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "Andy Kaufman pranks" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify that the topic isn't already covered under a different title or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the intended title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can reveal existing coverage or related articles; linking pages may indicate the topic is covered elsewhere or needs a redirect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider recent-creation propagation delays
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect the article was just created, allow time for replication or use the purge action to refresh the view before creating a duplicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check title capitalization and consider adding redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, if appropriate, create or request redirects so readers can find the page under alternate spellings/capitalizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: If page was deleted, consult the deletion log and deletion guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewing the deletion log and deletion rationale helps determine whether the topic can be recreated in a compliant form or whether issues need to be addressed first.
